name: 07 - Core - Create Appointment - Schedule Guarded V2

parameters.query:
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_patients_clinic_mobile
    ON patients(clinic_id, mobile);

WITH request_data AS (
    SELECT
        $1::TEXT AS clinic_name,
        $2::TEXT AS doctor_name,
        $3::TEXT AS service_name,
        $4::TEXT AS patient_name,
        $5::TEXT AS mobile,
        $6::DATE AS target_date,
        $7::TIME AS start_time,
        $8::TEXT AS visit_reason
),

base_context AS (
    SELECT
        c.id AS clinic_id,
        c.name AS clinic_name,
        c.timezone,

        d.id AS doctor_id,
        d.full_name AS doctor_name,
        d.buffer_minutes,

        s.id AS service_id,
        s.name AS service_name,
        s.duration_minutes,

        r.patient_name,
        r.mobile,
        r.target_date,
        r.start_time,
        r.visit_reason

    FROM request_data r

    INNER JOIN clinics c
        ON c.name = r.clinic_name
       AND c.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN doctors d
        ON d.clinic_id = c.id
       AND d.full_name = r.doctor_name
       AND d.is_active = TRUE

    INNER JOIN services s
        ON s.clinic_id = c.id
       AND s.name = r.service_name
       AND s.is_active = TRUE

    ORDER BY d.id, s.id
    LIMIT 1
),

valid_slot AS (
    SELECT
        bc.*,

        slot.slot_start_local,

        slot.slot_start_local
            AT TIME ZONE bc.timezone
            AS starts_at,

        (
            slot.slot_start_local
            + make_interval(mins => bc.duration_minutes)
        ) AT TIME ZONE bc.timezone
            AS ends_at

    FROM base_context bc

    INNER JOIN doctor_schedules ds
        ON ds.doctor_id = bc.doctor_id
       AND ds.is_active = TRUE
       AND ds.weekday =
            EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM bc.target_date)::INTEGER
       AND (
            ds.valid_from IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_from <= bc.target_date
       )
       AND (
            ds.valid_to IS NULL
            OR ds.valid_to >= bc.target_date
       )

    CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
        bc.target_date + ds.start_time,

        bc.target_date
            + ds.end_time
            - make_interval(mins => bc.duration_minutes),

        make_interval(
            mins => bc.duration_minutes + bc.buffer_minutes
        )
    ) AS slot(slot_start_local)

    WHERE slot.slot_start_local =
          bc.target_date + bc.start_time

    LIMIT 1
),

slot_state AS (
    SELECT
        vs.*,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM schedule_exceptions se

            WHERE se.doctor_id = vs.doctor_id
              AND se.is_active = TRUE
              AND se.exception_type = 'unavailable'

              AND se.starts_at < vs.ends_at
              AND se.ends_at > vs.starts_at
        ) AS is_blocked,

        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM appointments existing

            WHERE existing.doctor_id = vs.doctor_id
              AND existing.status IN ('pending', 'confirmed')

              AND existing.starts_at < vs.ends_at
              AND existing.ends_at > vs.starts_at
        ) AS has_appointment_conflict

    FROM valid_slot vs
),

upsert_patient AS (
    INSERT INTO patients (
        clinic_id,
        full_name,
        mobile
    )

    SELECT
        clinic_id,
        patient_name,
        mobile

    FROM slot_state

    WHERE starts_at > NOW()
      AND is_blocked = FALSE
      AND has_appointment_conflict = FALSE

    ON CONFLICT (clinic_id, mobile)
    DO UPDATE SET
        full_name = EXCLUDED.full_name,
        updated_at = NOW()

    RETURNING
        id,
        clinic_id,
        full_name,
        mobile
),

inserted_appointment AS (
    INSERT INTO appointments (
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        patient_id,
        service_id,
        starts_at,
        ends_at,
        status,
        booking_source,
        visit_reason
    )

    SELECT
        ss.clinic_id,
        ss.doctor_id,
        p.id,
        ss.service_id,
        ss.starts_at,
        ss.ends_at,
        'confirmed',
        'assistant',
        ss.visit_reason

    FROM slot_state ss

    INNER JOIN upsert_patient p
        ON p.clinic_id = ss.clinic_id
       AND p.mobile = ss.mobile

    ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

    RETURNING
        id,
        clinic_id,
        doctor_id,
        patient_id,
        service_id,
        starts_at,
        ends_at,
        status
)

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base_context)
            THEN 'configuration_not_found'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM valid_slot)
            THEN 'invalid_target_slot'
        WHEN (
            SELECT starts_at <= NOW()
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'target_time_in_past'
        WHEN (
            SELECT is_blocked
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'blocked_by_schedule_exception'
        WHEN (
            SELECT has_appointment_conflict
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'slot_unavailable'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_appointment)
            THEN 'created'
        ELSE 'slot_unavailable'
    END AS result,

    CASE
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM base_context)
            THEN 'کلینیک، پزشک یا خدمت مطابق ورودی پیدا نشد.'
        WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM valid_slot)
            THEN 'زمان انتخاب‌شده با برنامه کاری پزشک تطابق ندارد.'
        WHEN (
            SELECT starts_at <= NOW()
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'زمان انتخاب‌شده باید مربوط به آینده باشد.'
        WHEN (
            SELECT is_blocked
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'این بازه زمانی در برنامه پزشک مسدود شده است.'
        WHEN (
            SELECT has_appointment_conflict
            FROM slot_state
        )
            THEN 'زمان انتخاب‌شده در دسترس نیست.'
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM inserted_appointment)
            THEN 'نوبت با موفقیت ثبت شد.'
        ELSE 'زمان انتخاب‌شده در دسترس نیست.'
    END AS message,

    (
        SELECT id
        FROM inserted_appointment
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS appointment_id,

    r.patient_name,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT doctor_name
            FROM base_context
        ),
        r.doctor_name
    ) AS doctor_name,

    COALESCE(
        (
            SELECT service_name
            FROM base_context
        ),
        r.service_name
    ) AS service_name,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            starts_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM valid_slot
    ) AS appointment_start,

    (
        SELECT TO_CHAR(
            ends_at AT TIME ZONE timezone,
            'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'
        )
        FROM valid_slot
    ) AS appointment_end,

    (
        SELECT status
        FROM inserted_appointment
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS status

FROM request_data r;

SELECT
    a.id AS appointment_id,
    a.starts_at,
    a.ends_at,
    a.status,

    c.name AS clinic_name,
    c.timezone,

    d.full_name AS doctor_name,

    p.full_name AS patient_name,
    p.mobile AS patient_mobile,

    s.name AS service_name,

    a.visit_reason,
    a.google_calendar_event_id

FROM appointments a

INNER JOIN clinics c
    ON c.id = a.clinic_id

INNER JOIN doctors d
    ON d.id = a.doctor_id

INNER JOIN patients p
    ON p.id = a.patient_id

LEFT JOIN services s
    ON s.id = a.service_id

WHERE a.id = $1
  AND a.google_calendar_event_id IS NULL;

UPDATE appointments
SET
    google_calendar_event_id = $1,
    updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $2
RETURNING
    id AS appointment_id,
    google_calendar_event_id,
    status,
    starts_at,
    ends_at;
